notes.title: Major Update #1
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42858083/b25e01250877f76f28b7eef0f3239f930318608a.jpg"]

SYSTEM / FEATURES
ADDED: FSR (AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution) has been added to the settings. (Default: Enable)

FIXED: White glare issue caused by Global Illumination Quality settings.

[hr][/hr]

GRAPHICS / ART
FIXED: Issue related to Volumetric Fog.

FIXED: Lights are taking too long to activate in certain areas.

FIXED: Faruk Bey is getting stuck in specific environmental spots.

FIXED: Foliage (vegetation) issues in certain cinematic sequences.

FIXED: Collision problems in the cave section.

IMPROVED: GPU and CPU performance.

IMPROVED: NPC face textures.

IMPROVED: Local volumetric fog.

IMPROVED: Lighting and visual quality in certain cinematic sequences.

IMPROVED: Lighting and optimization in the Dream Sequence.

IMPROVED: Outfit and face models for Börü Alp and Serdar Alp.

IMPROVED: NPCs that previously had movement/stuck issues.

IMPROVED: Variety in NPC faces and textures.

ADDED: Training NPCs in the Training Ground.


[hr][/hr]

GAMEPLAY / PROGRAMMING
FIXED: Critical bug related to throwable barrels.

FIXED: Enemies spawning underground in some situations.

FIXED: Critical issue related to entering the Shaman Boss area.

FIXED: Critical bug causing Nightmares to spawn in unreachable locations in the Dream Level.

FIXED: A Cinematics in the Dream Level not triggering and breaking the game.

FIXED: VFX issues caused by Debuff Effects in some cinematics.

FIXED: Walking issue encountered during the Horse Care mission.

FIXED: Bug related to posture-break finisher not working properly.

FIXED: Audio cut-off for Faruk Bey in the Training mission.

FIXED: Ability to cancel attacks repeatedly in the Training mission.

FIXED: Minor bug related to quick weapon equip.

BALANCED: Combat mechanics for the Miroxar Boss.

BALANCED: Damage value of one of Turgut’s Skills.

BALANCED: Damage values related to the Snake’s Debuff Effect.

IMPROVED: Animations and sound effects for the Miroxar Boss.

IMPROVED: Dodge behavior after Kick, Block, and Parry.

IMPROVED: Enemy AI combat behaviors.

ADDED: When using Horse Summon, weapons will no longer be auto-equipped.

ADDED: Inverse Kinematics (IK) system for Horse, Wolf, and Deer legs.


[hr][/hr]

AUDIO / LOCALIZATION
FIXED: Audio issues in some cinematic scenes.

FIXED: Several translation issues in Arabic.

IMPROVED: Crying woman sound effects.

IMPROVED: Ambient sounds of some NPCs in the tribe.

IMPROVED: Volume levels of jackal death and growling sounds.

IMPROVED: Sound effect for when enemies detect the player.

IMPROVED: Waterfall sound dynamics.

IMPROVED: Sound dynamics of certain NPCs.

IMPROVED: Subtitles for some in-game dialogue.

ADDED: Drum sounds at the entrance of the tribe.

UI / UX

ADDED: Upscale Frame Generation option in Settings > Graphics.

ADDED: Weapon swap button customization in the "Settings" menu.

ADDED: Social media access buttons added to the main menu.

ADDED: Widescreen (32:9) background support for the main menu.

IMPROVED: Font size increased in the horse menu.

notes.title: First Day Bug Fix [V.0.80.239.544]
notes.notes:
Ertugrul of Ulukayin - V.0.80.239.544
First Day Bug Fix

DEVELOPER NOTES


PROGRAMMING

FIXED: Bug where the horse could be summoned right after Turgut and Meryem exited the cave.

FIXED: Issue where the player would start in the sky after the jackal fight cinematic.

FIXED: Game-breaking bug allowing players to enter through the backdoor during the Shaman confrontation.

FIXED: Flickering and visibility issues with Ertuğrul during the Shaman death cinematic.

FIXED: Dream sequence bug where early nightmares spawned in unreachable areas and broke the game.

FIXED: Final nightmare cinematic not triggering after defeating the last enemy in Ertuğrul’s dream.

FIXED: Poor performance for players who previously played the demo or an older Epic Games version.

FIXED: Underground spawning issue with NPCs during the mission to confront the Shaman.

FIXED: Exploit where players could spam the bow using left-click.

FIXED: Game-breaking bug allowing Meryem to leave the Armenian village before completing the required objectives.

FIXED: Game-breaking bug when trying to grab barrels using right-click.

FIXED: Bug causing companion NPCs to teleport suddenly when looked at.

FIXED: Friendly characters dying unexpectedly during the Mongol raid near the Weavery.

IMPROVED: Added visual feedback (VFX) when poisoned by a snake bite.

IMPROVED: Added a marker in the deer hunting mission to prevent the deer from becoming unfindable in the final stages.


LEVEL DESIGN

FIXED: Increased water availability and accessibility in the antidote crafting area during the snake encounter mission.

FIXED: Dagger floating mid-air when thrown in specific cave areas during Turgut’s encounter with cannibals.


AUDIO/SUBTITLES

FIXED: Missing voice lines for certain NPCs in the tribe.

IMPROVED: Various foley, dialogue, and subtitle polish.

FIXED: Missing subtitles during the final cinematic.


UI/UX

FIXED: Game-breaking issue where buttons in the initial disclaimer screen did not respond.

IMPROVED: Added reminders for Turgut’s "Skills" and "Attributes" when starting the game with him.
